title: kbtools.py shows no MCP: kb_tools on its own catalog line although the kb_tools MCP tool runs it
goal: the module docstring of kbtools.py ends with an MCP: kb_tools line, so its catalog line names the tool that runs it

run:
import subprocess, sys

r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbtools.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
line = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('kbtools.py ')]
ok = r.returncode == 0 and len(line) == 1 and 'kb_tools' in line[0]
print('exit', r.returncode, '| the kbtools.py catalog line:', line[0][:160] if line else '(none)')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
